scope: Reversible Xcode device-symbol cache relocation for authorized Matrx Extend localhost QA
result: The exact Chrome profile filesystem increased from 18.615345 to 23.897610 GiB available by relocating one inactive Xcode device-symbol cache to the external volume and preserving its original path as a symlink. The 20 GiB floor is currently clear; the resource runner must still perform its own fresh admission before a build or browser lease.

observations.boot_available_initial: 19 GiB (rounded df -h output; exact KiB unavailable at that observation)
observations.mutation: Only the exact Xcode device-symbol cache was copied to the external volume, byte-verified, linked from its original path, and its old local allocation removed. No other cache, profile, worktree, user file, build, test, or browser was touched. Earlier xcrun simctl activated CoreSimulator services; the reason for the preceding free-space fluctuation remains unknown.

relocation.contents: Xcode device support symbols under Symbols/System and Symbols/usr; 4264 regular files and zero symlinks at source before copying.
relocation.preflight: No source lsof references, no Xcode/debugserver/symbolicate/resource-runner process, no destination collision. Source inode 2869675 and original directory mtime were checked before switch; exact Chrome profile Node statfs reported 18.615345001220703 GiB available immediately before switch.
relocation.copy_and_verify: ditto --rsrc --extattr copied into the staging path. diff -rq returned zero with no differences both before and after the source rename; source and destination each occupied 5532452 KiB, contained 4264 regular files, and had matching directory mtime/ownership/mode. A fresh lsof found no references before removing the old local copy.
relocation.switch: Renamed staging to final destination, renamed original directory to same-parent .relocation-old, created an absolute symlink at the original path, verified readlink and realpath resolved to the final destination, then removed only the verified .relocation-old directory. The old copy is absent and the external destination remains intact.
relocation.rollback: When no Xcode work is active and boot space permits, copy the external destination to a temporary sibling of the original path with ditto --rsrc --extattr, byte-compare it to the external destination, remove only the original-path symlink, rename the verified temporary directory to the original path, and then remove the external copy only after confirming Xcode resolves the restored directory. The external copy itself remains the durable rollback source until that final step.

isolated_browser_option.method: Start a separate native Chrome instance with --user-data-dir pointing to the proposed external profile; load the existing development unpacked extension through chrome://extensions, then hold the existing stabilization-resource browser lease with --profile-dir set to that exact profile for the full manual session. Keep primary Chrome windows/profile untouched and stop only the owned Chrome process on exit.
isolated_browser_option.prerequisites: Create the proposed profile directory only when starting the QA session; verify the unpacked extension ID matches the stable development ID before sign-in. This does not relax the 20 GiB repo/profile filesystem guard, so boot recovery is still needed if the repo or other prerequisite uses the boot volume.
